theme_a: Instrument Development and Psychometric Validation in Engineering Education
theme_b: Factor Analysis as Primary Validation Method
description: Factor analysis (EFA/CFA) is the core method within psychometric validation studies, used across most instrument development research to establish construct validity and reliability. The Factor Analysis theme explicitly deepens this methodological focus.

theme_b: Linking Student Attributes to Career Intentions and Professional Outcomes
description: Self-efficacy and engineering identity are directly modeled as predictors of career persistence and entrepreneurial intentions, with many studies establishing mediating or predictive paths.

theme_a: Motivation and Engagement in Engineering Education
theme_b: Affective and Motivational Factors in Professional Skill Development
description: Both themes address intrinsic and extrinsic motivation, self-regulation, and emotional factors, but the former focuses on general academic engagement while the latter connects these factors specifically to professional skill development (e.g., writing, teamwork).

theme_a: Assessment of Generic, Transversal, and Professional Competencies
theme_b: Attitudes Toward Engineering and Practical Learning Experiences
description: One measures actual competency levels, while the other captures students’ attitudes toward those very competencies, offering a combined view of skill proficiency and disposition.

theme_b: Instrument Development and Psychometric Validation in Engineering Education
description: Rubric-based assessment often employs content validation (expert judgment) and inter-rater reliability, which are integral parts of broad instrument development processes, though rubrics may emphasize qualitative consistency over factor analysis.

theme_a: Critical, Reflective, and Representational Thinking Assessment
description: Both involve higher-order cognitive skills: critical thinking and reflection overlap with intellectual competences required for research, and both use instruments to measure complex problem-solving abilities.
